raw_new_human_elevated_carry.definition: close command, post-action bowl center z > original tabletop bowl center z + 3 cm, and post_On false; actual bowl elevated, strongest available carry proxy (contact/relative grasp still not directly certified)
raw_new_human_elevated_carry.state_delta_caveat: post_state-state displacement is within stored observation pair. It is smaller than next-pre_state minus current-pre_state; cached/regenerated observation timing differs, so dividing it by control_dt is only a derived nominal rate, not independently measured wall-clock or full-control-cycle speed.

scenario_match.note: Layout + bowl offset identity match does not establish identical failing gripper pose, history or post-contact observation.

sampling.method: uniform over combined public and correction frames

limitations: Closed-high proxy is not verified carry; public parquet has no bowl pose or post-action state.
EEF displacement per frame is reported separately from action amplitude. Public nominal 10 Hz and human physical 20 Hz differ; do not equate nominal video duration to physical action velocity.
Data distribution supports slow target imitation but cannot alone establish model causality, harmful overfitting, or generalization.
No changes to normalization, data, models, GUI or training.
